{{Nickname}}
{{Quote|It's not paranoia, my friend. Everybody assumed Dal'Nay was one of those vaunted "heroes of Cularin." All he did was betray the people who trained him and then use their training against them. Just like he used Kulkis's knife against him. Now he's leaked this, so that everyone can tell him he's a hero, even though he knows he isn't.|ostenmustdie, posting on the Cularin holonet node|<ref name="everyone's a critic">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050331b|text=Everyone's a Critic}}</ref>}}
The handle '''ostenmustdie''' was the user ID of an individual active on the [[Cularin holonet node]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following the posting<ref name="everyone's a critic" /> on the Cularin [[HoloNet/Legends|holonet]]<ref name="the best defense">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050310b|text=The Best Defense}}</ref> of a story depicting the [[Death/Legends|killing]] of the [[Thaereian military]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Kulkis]] by the enlisted [[Soldier/Legends|solider]] [[Nightwing]], speculation arose that [[Osten Dal'Nay]] of the [[Cularin Militia]] had wrote the story and was the true identity of Nightwing. The user ostenmustdie advocated this theory and posted on the Cularin holonet node to denigrate Dal'Nay and describe him as a murderer.<ref name="everyone's a critic" />
